 Grand Theft Auto fan is organizing an in-game ‘Last Ride’ event in GTA Online ahead of GTA 6’s release
 By Chris Neal -      
 November 16, 2026 6:00 PM 
 2 
 While we still don’t know what the future holds for  Grand Theft Auto VI’s online multiplayer component beyond the fact that  it’s going to be a thing , we can also surmise that a great deal of  Grand Theft Auto Online players might disappear from the virtual city once the single-player game  arrives . So why not bid goodbye to that world for a time  with a big ol’ in-game event in the sandbox?
 Content creator CraftizyTV is organizing what he calls a “Last Ride” event that will encourage players to hop into GTA Online on Wednesday, November 18th, for one last in-game drive around the world of Los Santos as a tribute to the 13-year-old title. Players are being encouraged to arrive at the Los Santos Airport with their favorite car and clothes, then join in on a circuit through the city’s major landmarks, ending up on top of Mount Chiliad.
 Much of this appears to be fixated on dropping gamertags in Craftizy’s Tiktok uploads to note interest, so it doesn’t really seem all that well organized or specifically timed. Still, if you happen to be eager to join in on what may be a big social gathering in  GTAO before the atomic bomb of  GTA 6 arrives, at least you have a general date and location for when to show up for one last ride.
 source:  GamesRadar
